(3) Measurement-System Configuration and Metadata (Site Deployment) As part of Task 7, the project completed installation and configuration of high-speed measurement systems at the Wheatridge hybrid plant. The data resources generated include: • Configuration and metadata for all installed PPMS units, including channel assignments, sampling specifications, measurement-location mapping, and device parameters. • Metadata and documentation supporting future field-measurement ingestion, synchronization, and comparison against EMT and HIL model outputs. These measurement-system resources form the foundation for event capture, model validation, and system-level analysis during the future demonstration phase. 10.5 Collaborations The project facilitated technical collaboration across utilities, research institutions, universities, and technology developers.
